notes: The Semaphore of the Telegraph Hill Dwellers, nos. 150 to 252 (Winter 1999 to Summer 2026): the 102 later issues in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers, which have no hOCR. Source text and leaves are rebuilt from each item's _djvu.xml (/mnt/project-files/mission-papers/dl_djvu.py); citations give the issue number and the leaf. One duplicate upload of no. 247 was left out. Read by hand, with no reader pass; extra.candidate is the row key in /mnt/project-files/mission-papers/decisions_semaphore_late.py. Kept: the building dates and first owners of the pre-1906 houses in the Telegraph Hill Historic District, from the list the paper printed in no. 175 out of Anne Bloomfield's district report, with the fuller accounts of no. 215 where it has them; documented past occupants (Sargent Johnson's rooms are unplaced; Wolo's studio, Frida Kahlo and Diego Rivera on Calhoun Terrace, Friedel Klussmann's house); openings, moves, closures and fires; and decisions the commission minutes had not already put on the page. Not kept: the Dwellers' positions, proposals on private houses, anything about a current resident or owner, advertisements, and the Beat and gay-bar listings where the city's context statements already put them on the page. First owners are named only for houses of 1852 to 1902. A business is named without its owners. extra.number_as_printed keeps a number the paper printed differently from the parcel's page (120-22 Alta paged at 122, 467 Broadway at 463, 494 Broadway at 490). extra.record_date is the issue year for facts older than the paper. Where the district's date for a house differs from the assessor's roll, extra.unknown_sentence says so and is carried to the page.

coverage.remaining: Nothing remains in The Semaphore: with semaphore-1976-1999 the title is read whole, 194 issues.
coverage.note: 102 issues; 3,969 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (ocr_mentions.py --rescue), most of them advertisements, gallery listings and Muni line numbers. The filter kept 874 windows, merged into 622 passages, all read by hand. 110 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 105 resolved and published on 94 pages (27 seeded: 23 houses of the historic district, 260 Green, 1620 Montgomery, 801 Greenwich, 1196 Columbus). 2 held, each one thin fact on a parcel with no page (2237 Powell, 801 Pacific). 3 unplaced at numbers no parcel carries today (1517 Grant, 299 Broadway, 345 Pacific). Seeding 1620 Montgomery took up the fact semaphore-1976-1999 had held for it (the 90-foot office plan of 1984). Not carried, the pages having them already: the Colombo Building, the Old Spaghetti Factory, the Italian Swiss Colony building, the Malt House, the Paper Doll, the Buon Gusto factory, City Lights, Julius' Castle, the Gibb warehouses, and nearly every Planning Commission vote of 2000 to 2005. 36 houses carry a sentence setting the district's date against the assessor's roll; the Savoy Tivoli's page sets its 1913 building permit against the 1907 on its awning, and 31 Alta's the paper's two dates for it.
